title: Grow Cardano DeFi with transparent on-chain Fund Management platform

ms.promise:
Implement and Deploy on testnet for core feature
 - Create/Update/Manage Club
 - Club List
 - Deposit To/Withdraw from Club
 - Force Liquidated
 - Close Club

With these features:
 - For Club Operator (OP) :
 + OPs can create a Club, calculate NAV of their club, close club
 + OPs can deposit to a Club, withdraw from club
 - For community : View and choose to join a Club, withdraw to get back ADA, Force Liquidated of club if there is no activity.

Note: At this milestone, we add the forced liquidation feature and close club feature, remove staking feature (this feature will be on next mile stone):
 - During our analysis, we found it necessary to add a mechanism to protect participants' interests in case the club takes no action. So we add force liquidated feature
 - To allow the OP to withdraw their funds, the club must close and all members must withdraw their money. This mechanism ensures the rights and interests of the community when participating in the club.
These features need to be implement before implementing any investment features.
ms.criteria:
- Deploy features on testnet
- Reach 20 user (wallet) are experiencing the features on the testnet. "Experiencing" here mean they do at least 1 action:
create/update club, Deposit To/Withdraw from Club, Manage Club by Calculating NAV
- At leaset 20 clubs was created on testnet
